notes.title: Free Update #12 - Twins
notes.content:
Its been a while coming but Game #15 - Whorlwind III: Twins - has now been added to Awesome Mix Tape!!!

A similar setup to the prequels but now you face the task of controlling 2 objects at the same time. Gives it that patting-your-head-and-rubbing-your-stomach feeling... needs a better name for that feeling.

This update also includes 3 more achievements (taking our running total to 55 now) and some various little bug fixes along the way.

The next 3 games that make up tape 6 should involve less of a wait as the central mechanic of each game is already there so they just need some polishing and finishing.

Thanks to everyone who has been downloading and playing Awesome Mix Tape over the last few months as it gave me the incentive to get back to the games.

notes.title: Free Update #11 - QOL
notes.content:
Our 11th free update focuses on some quality-of-life improvements following feedback from players.

[list]
[*] An improved Jamesian Wallop - now find what's missing rather than what's appeared. Much more challenging.
[*] Improved tutorials following feedback our players. They are a bit more specific now to be more useful.
[*] We've locked medley mode to avoid confusion if someone plays that first. Unlocks after playing 20 games.
[/list]

Once again, thanks to everyone who has bought and enjoyed our collection of gaming snacks so far.
There are 4 more games that are about ready so its just a matter of trying to decide which ones to finish off and add. Choices, choices....

[previewyoutube=NVzqOfnuMg4;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow us on Twitter for the latest updates.

notes.title: Free Update #4 - We Come In Peace
notes.content:
Welcome to our fourth FREE update!

[list]
[*] Game 10 is now available - We Come In Peace. Previously we made a twist on Space Invaders but, this time, it's the classic gameplay you know and love.
[*] 3 new achievements, including one for those players who discover our insta-load cartridges.
[*] We've added lots of colour themes to the Whorlwind games. Simply play the game and, every time you cross the finish line, the colours will randomly remix into a different theme.
[/list]
Our short-form, Actraiser-inspired game is almost ready so next month could be a cracker.

Once again, thanks to everyone who has bought and enjoyed our collection of gaming snacks so far. We're adding loads of new games throughout 2021 - here is a sneak preview of what may come...

notes.title: Free Update #2: Phoenix Rising!
notes.content:
Welcome to our second BIG free update!
New Tape, New Mix, All Awesome!

Lots of good stuff this month:
[list]
[*] We've added a 4th mix tape to the collection. Only one game at the moment but lots of room for us to copy ... err ... backup new games onto it in the future.
[*] Our 8th game has been added - Phoenix Rising - a skillful game of fiery collection where you strive to keep the Phoenix burning. Cool fact: The whole thing is made of particles.
[*] We've added 3 new achievements for our new game.
[*] The loading times of cassette slightly too retro for you? We've introduced insta-load cartridges for all our games. Isn't the future ace? You just have to find them...
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who has bought and enjoyed our initial collection of gaming snacks so far. We're adding loads of new games throughout 2021 - here is a sneak preview of what may come...
[previewyoutube=NVzqOfnuMg4;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow us on Twitter for the lastest updates or join our discord to see developments as they happen.

notes.title: Free Update #1: Super Bomb Drop!
notes.content:
Welcome to our first big update!
Thanks to everyone who bought and enjoyed our initial collection of gaming snacks.

For this update, we've added a whole new game to Awesome Mix Tape - Super Bomb Drop!
A minimalistic test of timing - drop your bombs at passing targets but stay away from the red mines that will bring down your time limit if destroyed.
Alongside our new favourite game, we've also added 3 new achievements to test your skill.

More games coming throughout 2021 so follow us on Twitter or join our discord to keep up-to-date with what's coming next!
